''Mirasolia'' (Sch.Bip.) La Duke |synonyms_ref = {{cite web |url=http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/genus.pl?12171 |title=''Tithonia'' Desf. ex Juss. |work=Germplasm Resources Information Network |publisher=United States Department of Agriculture |date=1996-09-17 |accessdate=2010-06-06}} }} [[File:Tithonia 1.jpg|thumb|Red Tithonia]] '''''Tithonia''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the tribe [[Heliantheae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]].[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/5437421#page/284/mode/1up Jussieu, Antoine Laurent de. 1789. Genera Plantarum 189] in Latin{{cite web|url=http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40014926 |title=Tropicos, "Tithonia" Desf. ex Juss |publisher=Tropicos.org |date= |accessdate=2018-08-31}} ''Tithonia'' has a center of distribution in [[Mexico]] but with one species extending into the [[Southwestern United States]] and several native to [[Central America]]. Two species, ''[[Tithonia diversifolia|T. diversifolia]]'' and ''[[Tithonia rotundifolia|T. rotundifolia]]'', are widely cultivated and have escaped to become [[weed]]s in tropical and subtropical areas around the world. ''[[Tithonia rotundifolia|T. rotundifolia]]'' makes a nice fresh cut flower, flowering in mid- to late-summer in the Northern hemisphere.{{Cite web|title=Growing Tithonia (Mexican Sunflower) from Seed {{!}} Johnny's Selected Seeds|url=https://www.johnnyseeds.com/growers-library/flowers/tithonia-mexican-sunflower/tithonia-mexican-sunflower-key-growing-information.html|access-date=2020-08-31|website=www.johnnyseeds.com}} The distinguishing feature of the genus is the [[peduncle (botany)|peduncle]], which is fistulose (meaning hollow and flaring toward the apex). The plants are coarse [[Annual plant|annual]] or [[Perennial plant|perennial]] [[Herbaceous plant|herbs]] or [[shrub]]s, and one species, ''[[Tithonia koelzii|T. koelzii]]'', is a small [[tree]].{{cite web|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=133067 |title=Flora of North America, Vol. 21 Page 138, Sunflowerweed, "Tithonia" Desfontaines ex Jussieu, Gen.
